definitions.gloss: lady; gentlewoman; woman of refined character
definitions.explanation: A woman of good breeding and graceful manners. Used in formal or literary contexts to describe an elegant, well-mannered woman.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{淑女|しゅくじょ}のようにふるまった。
{紳士|しんし}{淑女|しゅくじょ}の{皆|みな}さま、ようこそ。
{祖母|そぼ}は{昔|むかし}から{淑女|しゅくじょ}としての{教育|きょういく}を{受|う}けてきた。
examples.english: My grandmother was raised with the education of a lady from a young age.

notes:
{淑女|しゅくじょ} is a formal, somewhat literary word for a refined, well-mannered woman. It is rarely used in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Most frequently encountered in the set phrase {紳士|しんし}{淑女|しゅくじょ}の{皆|みな}さま (ladies and gentlemen), used at formal events and ceremonies.

PAIR WORD:
- {紳士|しんし}: gentleman (male counterpart)

REGISTER:
Formal, literary, or old-fashioned. In everyday speech, {女性|じょせい} (woman) is far more common. {淑女|しゅくじょ} carries connotations of elegance, modesty, and good upbringing that make it sound ceremonial or bookish in casual contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {女性|じょせい}: woman (neutral, everyday)
- {婦人|ふじん}: lady, woman (formal, seen in signage and formal writing)
- レディー: lady (loanword, casual)
